title: Works Cited
use_cases: Use when researching academic foundations of computational narratology
Use when implementing structuralist models like Propp or Bremond in code
Use when citing historical precedents for interactive storytelling systems
Use when benchmarking modern NLP narrative extraction against baseline literature
Use when designing suspense mechanisms based on psychological reader models
